name: General Ledger - Parent and Child Customers
query:
SELECT 
    IF(cust.custom_is_child_company = 1, CONCAT("  - ", cust.customer_name), cust.customer_name) AS customer_display,
    parent_cust.customer_name AS parent_customer,
    gl.posting_date,
    gl.voucher_type,
    gl.voucher_no,
    gl.account,
    gl.party_type,
    gl.party,
    gl.debit,
    gl.credit,
    (gl.debit - gl.credit) AS net_amount
FROM `tabGL Entry` gl
LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cust ON gl.party = cust.name
LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` parent_cust ON cust.custom_parent_company = parent_cust.name
WHERE 
    gl.party_type = 'Customer'
    AND (cust.custom_is_child_company = 1 OR cust.custom_parent_company IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY parent_cust.customer_name ASC, cust.customer_name ASC, gl.posting_date ASC;
report_name: General Ledger - Parent and Child Customers
